description: Recipe top-level contract and native serializers verified against RecipeSerializers.java in CraftEngine 26.8.

third_party_source_types.note: CraftEngine 26.8 has no cooking-pot serializer. Ingredients and result are preserved; the target station becomes a workbench. Experience/cooking-time are retained in IR diagnostics but are not representable in a crafting recipe.
Mapped to the SliceBoard recipe DSL (input, tools, outputs with min/max/chance).

note: Ingredient accepts a scalar item id, a tag (#namespace:tag), or a map {items, count, predicate}. Shaped recipes use `pattern` plus an `ingredients` mapping of single-char symbols. Unknown source serializers must be preserved in IR and reported as UNSUPPORTED rather than silently generated.
